name: Germany Legal
description:
Give Claude comprehensive German legal knowledge covering 12 practice areas of Bundesrecht with section-level statute citations and 16 interactive calculators. Every § is cited against verified German statutes from gesetze-im-internet.de, with current 2025 values, all 16 Bundesland variations where applicable, and a RDG-compliant disclaimer distinguishing Rechtsinformation from Rechtsberatung.

Practice areas include: contract law (BGB Books 1 and 2, AGB-Kontrolle §§305 to 310), employment law (KSchG, BetrVG, TzBfG, MiLoG, AGG), data protection (DSGVO, BDSG 2018, TTDSG), company law (GmbHG, AktG, HGB, GwG), intellectual property (UrhG, MarkenG, PatG, UWG), property law (BGB, GBO, GrEStG, Mietrecht), financial services (KWG, WpHG, ZAG, MiCAR), competition law (GWB, UWG), consumer law (BGB, ProdHaftG, PAngV), civil procedure (ZPO, GKG, RVG), tax law (EStG, KStG, GewStG, UStG, AO), and regulatory bodies (BaFin, BKartA, BfDI, DPMA).

Includes 16 interactive calculators: AGB clause checker, Verjährungsrechner, Streitwert to GKG and RVG fee calculator, Mindestlohnrechner, Kündigungsfristrechner, KSchG-Prüfer, Kurzarbeitergeld-Rechner, DSGVO-Compliance-Checker, Gewerbesteuerrechner, Grunderwerbsteuer-Rechner across all 16 Bundesländer, ELSTER-Fristenkalender, Transparenzregister-Pflicht-Checker, Insolvenzantragsfrist-Tracker, and beA/ERV-Pflicht-Checker. Built with anti-hallucination protection: the plugin never invents § numbers or BGH Aktenzeichen. 12 skills, 7 slash commands.
longDescription:
Ships **12 skills**, **7 commands** and **7 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (12): `civil-procedure` (German civil procedure (ZPO/Prozessrecht) — court system, Streitwert, GKG/RVG fees, Mahnverfahren, einstweilige Verfuegung, Prozesskostenhilfe, beA/ERV), `company-law` (German company law (Gesellschaftsrecht) — GmbH, UG, AG, GbR, KG, formation, liability, insolvency filing obligations, Transparenzregister), `competition-law` (German competition law (Wettbewerbsrecht) — GWB, Kartellverbot, Marktmissbrauch, Fusionskontrolle, Bundeskartellamt, GAFA-Klausel §19a), `consumer-law` (German consumer law (Verbraucherrecht) — §13/§14 BGB, Widerrufsrecht, ProdHaftG, PAngV, VSBG, Fernabsatzrecht), `contract-law` (German contract law (Vertragsrecht/Schuldrecht) — BGB Books 1-2, contract formation, AGB-Kontrolle, Leistungsstoerungen, Gewaehrleistung, Verjaehrung), `data-protection` (German data protection law (Datenschutzrecht) — DSGVO/GDPR, BDSG 2018, TTDSG), `employment-law` (German employment law (Arbeitsrecht) — KSchG, BetrVG, AGG, ArbZG, MiLoG, TzBfG, AUeG), `financial-services` (German financial services law (Finanzrecht) — KWG, WpHG, ZAG, KAGB, VAG, MiCAR, BaFin regulation), and 4 more
- **Commands** (7): `calculate-fees` (Calculate German court fees (GKG) and attorney fees (RVG) from a Streitwert (amount in dispute)), `calculate-tax` (Calculate German business taxes — GewSt (Gewerbesteuer), GrESt (Grunderwerbsteuer), ESt (Einkommensteuer), KSt (Koerperschaftsteuer), and more), `check-agb` (Analyze AGB (Allgemeine Geschaeftsbedingungen) clauses against §§305-310 BGB — schwarze Liste, graue Liste, Generalklausel), `check-dsgvo` (Run a DSGVO/BDSG compliance check on a data processing activity, product feature, or business initiative), `check-fristen` (Track legal deadlines (Fristen) and limitation periods (Verjaehrungsfristen) under German law), `check-kuendigung` (Check dismissal protection (Kuendigungsschutz) under KSchG, calculate notice periods (§622 BGB), and assess special protections), `review-vertrag` (Review a contract (Vertrag) against German law — flag BGB/HGB deviations, AGB issues, and generate redline suggestions)
- **MCP servers** (7): `slack`, `box`, `egnyte`, `atlassian`, `ms365`, `google-calendar`, `gmail`

Installs with `claude plugin install germany-legal@claude-community` from `mlobo2012/Germany-SMB-Legal-Plugin`.
